item.text:
**3B.8 Research Note**

**Bottom line:** Mixed, leaning permissive in rhetoric but not in practice. In 2024 Biden explicitly defended peaceful protest and rejected authoritarian suppression, and the DOJ had some protest-rights enforcement activity. The main counterevidence is the campus-protest crackdown environment: mass arrests, riot-police deployments, and broad campus restrictions. I did not find solid 2024 evidence of a deliberate White House surveillance campaign or direct retaliation against peaceful protest organizers; the negative evidence is mostly campus- and local-policing driven.

| Signal | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Remarks on Political Protests at College Campuses and an Exchange With Reporters](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-political-protests-college-campuses-and-exchange-reporters) | The American Presidency Project / White House | 2024-05-02 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-political-protests-college-campuses-and-exchange-reporters | Biden said free speech and peaceful assembly must be upheld, rejected authoritarian suppression of dissent, and framed peaceful protest as consistent with American tradition. | 3B.8 |
| Positive | [Biden breaks silence on college protests over Gaza conflict](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-breaks-silence-on-college-protests-over-gaza-conflict-3415253) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-02 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-breaks-silence-on-college-protests-over-gaza-conflict-3415253 | Reuters reported Biden said Americans have a right to demonstrate, while violence is not protected. That is direct pro-protest language, even if paired with a law-and-order caveat. | 3B.8 |
| Positive | [Justice Department Finds Civil Rights Violations by Phoenix Police Department and City of Phoenix](https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix) | U.S. Department of Justice | 2024-06-13 | https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix | Biden’s DOJ found police violated the rights of people engaged in demonstrations and protests, and singled out discriminatory enforcement against Black, Hispanic, and Native American people. That is evidence of federal protection against anti-protest abuse. | 3B.8 |
| Positive | [Justice Department Announces Significant Progress in Policing Reforms by the Baltimore Police Department and the City of Baltimore](https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-announces-significant-progress-policing-reforms-baltimore-police) | U.S. Department of Justice | 2024-12-16 | https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-announces-significant-progress-policing-reforms-baltimore-police | DOJ said Baltimore had implemented reforms protecting First Amendment-protected activities and protest rights. This supports a reading of federal support for lawful demonstration. | 3B.8 |
| Negative | [Riot police and over 2,000 arrests: A look at 2 weeks of campus protests](https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/interactive/2024/university-antiwar-campus-protests-arrests-data/?itid=lk_fullstory&itid=lk_inline_manual_26&itid=lk_inline_manual_5) | The Washington Post | 2024-05-03 | https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/interactive/2024/university-antiwar-campus-protests-arrests-data/?itid=lk_fullstory&itid=lk_inline_manual_26&itid=lk_inline_manual_5 | The report documented more than 2,000 campus arrests in a short span, with riot police monitoring or dispersing crowds and some use of tear gas, tasers, and stun grenades. That is strong evidence of a chilling enforcement climate around protest. | 3B.8 |
| Negative | [Police were advised to avoid mass arrests; then came the US campus protests](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-10 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913 | Reuters reported police swept up students in mass arrests across dozens of campuses despite advice to avoid that approach. This supports a selective or overbroad enforcement reading. | 3B.8 |
| Mixed | [Biden calls for peace following major clashes on prominent campuses](https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2024/05/02/college-student-protests-gaza-war/) | The Washington Post | 2024-05-02 | https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2024/05/02/college-student-protests-gaza-war/ | Biden urged students to remain peaceful and said order must prevail. This is supportive in principle, but it sits inside a broader crackdown environment that produced arrests and campus closures. | 3B.8 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Biden personally ordered retaliatory surveillance, blacklisting, or a federal campaign against peaceful protest organizers.
- The strongest negative evidence is not direct White House repression, but the campus-policing response around pro-Palestinian protests.
- Evidence on ordinary community organizing outside the campus/Gaza context was thin, so confidence should stay moderate rather than high.
